# nibbl

> Nibbl is a tiny pixel pet mod for Claude Code that lives above your prompt, hatches after 10 answered turns, eats bugs when your tests pass, and costs zero model tokens.

## What it is

A free, open-source (MIT) Claude Code mod. Every pet is unique, rolled once per machine on the server, with public odds (common 40%, uncommon 30%, rare 18%, epic 9%, legendary 3%, shiny 4% on top). It reacts to what really happens in your session: a bug appears on an error, it eats the bugs when checks pass, it carries a box on a commit, it goes on an expedition while Claude works and sleeps when you are away. It grows over months through five stages (egg, baby, teen, adult, elder). It never interrupts you and never reads your code.

## Install

In Claude Code:

    /plugin marketplace add https://getnibbl.pages.dev/marketplace.json
    /plugin install nibbl@nibbl

Alternative, from GitHub:

    /plugin marketplace add nuromirzak/nibbl

Auto-update is off by default for community marketplaces. To turn it on: `/plugin`, then Marketplaces, then nibbl, then Enable auto-update. Manual update: `/plugin marketplace update nibbl`, then `/plugin update nibbl@nibbl`, then restart.

## Commands

- `/nibbl`: name, serial, tier, level, XP, hearts, rarest trait, card and leaderboard links, rank, last note and wave
- `/nibbl pet`: pet it from the prompt (5 an hour give XP)
- `/nibbl name <text>`: rename your pet (once a week, up to 16 characters)
- `/nibbl label <text>`: set a label (up to 24 characters); `/nibbl label` alone clears it
- `/nibbl odds`: hatch odds and the odds of each of your pet's traits
- `/nibbl export`: show the secret code that moves your pet to another machine
- `/nibbl import <code>`: move a pet to this machine
- `/nibbl hide`: hide or show the band; the pet keeps living
- `/nibbl wave <serial>`: send a wave (a heart, no text, no XP) to another nibbl; 10 a day, one per nibbl per day
- `/nibbl notes`: list the notes from the maker you have received
- `/nibbl share` (0.3.0): print your card URL and a ready post text, no network call
- `/nibbl achievements` (0.3.0): unlocked achievements, and the next ones with progress
- `/nibbl invite [serial]` (0.3.0): invite a friend; a friend still on an egg runs it with your serial before hatching

## How XP works

The server computes XP, so a modified client cannot outgrow honest players. A pet gives 2 XP (5 per hour cap), a Claude turn gives 3 XP (20 per hour), a passing test, typecheck, lint or build gives 2 XP (20 per hour), and `git commit` gives 2 XP (10 per hour). Level n to n+1 costs round(10 * n^1.4) XP. Rarity never changes XP or level. Stages: baby at level 1, teen at 10, adult at 25, elder at 50.

## Privacy

What leaves your machine:

- A SHA-256 hash of your machine id plus a salt, your pet's serial and secret token, and the name, label and wave target serials you set yourself.
- Event types and times only (turn, check_pass, commit, error, pet, hide). Never prompts, code, file names, commands or outputs.
- Nothing else, and only to getnibbl.pages.dev. No accounts, no ads, no trackers.

Full policy, retention and how to delete your pet: https://getnibbl.pages.dev/privacy/

## Links

# Source: plugin/README.md

# Nibbl

A tiny pixel pet that lives above your Claude Code prompt. It hatches from an egg after 10 answered turns, reacts to what really happens in your session (a bug appears on an error, it eats the bugs when your tests pass, it carries a box when you commit, it goes on an expedition while Claude works and sleeps when you are away) and grows over months. It never costs a model token and never interrupts you.

## Install

    /plugin marketplace add https://getnibbl.pages.dev/marketplace.json
    /plugin install nibbl@nibbl

To get updates automatically: `/plugin`, **Marketplaces**, **nibbl**, **Enable auto-update** (Claude Code leaves it off for community marketplaces).

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/nibbl` | Name, serial, tier, level, XP, hearts, rarest trait, card and leaderboard links, your rank with the nibbl just above you, the last note and wave, and an update hint when a newer version is out |
| `/nibbl pet` | Pets it from the prompt |
| `/nibbl name <text>` | Rename your pet (once a week, up to 16 characters) |
| `/nibbl label <text>` | Set a label (up to 24 characters); `/nibbl label` alone clears it |
| `/nibbl wave <serial>` | Sends a wave (a heart, no text, no XP) to another nibbl: `16`, `#16` and `000016` all work. 10 a day, one per nibbl per day |
| `/nibbl notes` | Lists the notes from the maker you have received |
| `/nibbl odds` | Hatch odds and the odds of each of your pet's traits |
| `/nibbl export` | Shows the secret code that moves your pet to another machine |
| `/nibbl import <code>` | Moves a pet to this machine |
| `/nibbl hide` | Hides or shows the band; the pet keeps living |

Every couple of days a short note from the maker shows as a toast (20 notes in total, bundled in the mod, so they work offline). Waves you receive show as one toast per sync, and `/nibbl` shows `rank 4 of 26 · next: #000019 ...` so you know whom to wave at. There is no free-text chat. A toast also appears when you first reach the top 10, when you reach #1, and once per new version.

Type `/nibbl pet`, or focus the band with `ctrl+x tab` and press `p` (a click on `[♥]` works in the fullscreen terminal). Five pets an hour give XP; after that it still loves you, it just gives no XP.

## Odds

Every egg is rolled on the server, once per machine, with the same odds for everyone: common 40%, uncommon 30%, rare 18%, epic 9%, legendary 3%. Shiny is 4% on top of any tier (a legendary shiny is about 1 in 830). Every pet also rolls a mark with odds of 1 in 24 (4.17%), so each one has a trait rarer than 5%. `/nibbl odds` shows yours.

## What leaves your machine

- `machineHash`: the SHA-256 of your hardware id plus "nibbl". The id itself never leaves.
- Your pet's serial and token.
- The name and label you set with `/nibbl name` and `/nibbl label`. They show on your pet's public card and the leaderboard.
- The serial you wave at with `/nibbl wave <serial>`, so the server can deliver the wave. No text goes with it.
- Events: only the type (`turn`, `check_pass`, `commit`, `error`, `pet`, `hide`) and the time of each. Never your prompts, commands, file paths or outputs.

All of it goes to https://getnibbl.pages.dev and nowhere else. The export code is a secret: anyone who has it owns your pet, so it is drawn on your screen only and never sent to the model.

Full privacy policy, retention and how to delete your pet: https://getnibbl.pages.dev/privacy/

## Troubleshooting

- **No band above the prompt.** Nibbl needs a Claude Code version with mods (function hooks). Update Claude Code, then restart it. In a short terminal the band shrinks to one line; `/nibbl` always works.
- **Clicking `[♥]` or pressing `p` does nothing.** The band takes keys only when it has focus: press `ctrl+x tab` first, or use `/nibbl pet`.
- **Still an egg.** It hatches after 10 answered turns. `/nibbl` shows how many are left.
- **"Could not reach the nibbl server".** You are offline or the server is busy. Events wait in a local queue and sync later; nothing is lost.
- **New version not showing.** Community marketplaces do not auto-update: run `/plugin marketplace update nibbl`, then `/plugin update nibbl@nibbl`, and restart. Or turn on auto-update in `/plugin`, Marketplaces, nibbl.
- **Anything else.** Open an issue: https://github.com/nuromirzak/nibbl/issues

## Local testing

Run the API with `pnpm -C apps/api dev` and point the mod at it with `NIBBL_API=http://localhost:8787` (or the `Nibbl server` option in `/config`).

# Source: docs/how-it-works.md

# How nibbl works

The technical side, for the curious and for contributors. The [README](../README.md) is the short version.

## Repo layout

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `packages/core` | Zero-dependency TypeScript: odds, genome, pixel drawing, XP. The only implementation of the art and the rules, shared by the mod, the server and the website. |
| `apps/mod` | The Claude Code mod (function hooks). It draws the pet above the prompt, reacts to tool calls and turns, queues events locally and syncs them with the API. |
| `apps/api` | Cloudflare Worker + D1: hatch, sync, names, import, leaderboard, rank, card pages, PNG and SVG badges, cron. |
| `apps/web` | Cloudflare Pages project: the landing page, the leaderboard page and the plugin files. It forwards `/api/*` and `/p/*` to the Worker. |
| `tools/assets` | Regenerates the README GIFs and images from the real generator. |
| `docs/` | Spec, plans, decisions, infrastructure. |

## The pet

- **Scene:** 32×16 pixels, like the original Tamagotchi screen; the pet is up to 16×16. Drawn with half-block characters so it works in any truecolor terminal, with integer-only math so every runtime draws the same pixels.
- **Palette:** [Sweetie 16](https://lospec.com/palette-list/sweetie-16) by GrafxKid.
- **Genome:** family, body, palette, pattern, eyes, head, hat, mark. Every pet is unique: the server rejects a genome or a picture that already exists.
- **Stages:** egg, baby (level 1), teen (10), adult (25), elder (50).

## Odds

Every roll happens on the server, once per machine, forever. These are the real odds, the same ones the generator uses.

| Tier | Chance |
|---|---|
| Common | 40% |
| Uncommon | 30% |
| Rare | 18% |
| Epic | 9% |
| Legendary | 3% |
| Shiny (rolled separately, any tier) | 4% |

Every nibbl also carries at least one trait rarer than 5% (its mark: 24 kinds, each 1/24). Rarity never changes XP or level. The shown percentages are base odds, computed from the generator itself and checked against real roll frequencies in the tests.

## XP and hearts

| Event | XP | Cap per hour |
|---|---|---|
| Pet (click or hotkey) | 2 | 5 |
| A Claude turn | 3 | 20 |
| Tests, typecheck, lint or build passing | 2 | 20 |
| `git commit` | 2 | 10 |

The server computes XP, so a modified client cannot outgrow the most active honest player. Level n to n+1 costs `round(10 · n^1.4)` XP.

## Privacy

What leaves your machine, and nothing else:

| Data | Why |
|---|---|
| `machineHash` (SHA-256 of your hardware UUID plus a salt) | So the same machine always gets the same pet. The raw UUID never leaves. |
| `serial` and `token` | Your pet's id and its secret. The server stores only a hash of the token. |
| The serial you wave at (`/nibbl wave <serial>`) | So the server can deliver the wave to that nibbl. No text, only the number. |
| Event counts (type and time: turn, check passed, commit, error, pet, hide) | To compute XP on the server with hourly caps. |

- No code, prompts, file names, commands or outputs are ever sent. The mod sees that a test passed, not what the test was.
- Zero model tokens: reactions are plain code, not model calls.
- Your IP address is visible to Cloudflare like any web request; the API keeps only a daily-salted hash of it, for a per-day hatch limit.
- Sync runs every few hours and at session end. Offline, the pet keeps living and events wait in a local queue.

## Infrastructure

Everything is code: `apps/api/wrangler.jsonc`, `apps/web/wrangler.toml`, SQL migrations and provisioning scripts. The full inventory, deploy runbook and free-tier budget are in [docs/infra.md](infra.md).

## Development

```
pnpm install
pnpm test          # every suite
pnpm assets        # regenerate README images
pnpm -C apps/api dev
```
